title: Local EXTRACT Independent Review v1
goal: Provide an independent, durable review/support lane for research-engine-local-extract-redesign-v1 while preserving a single EXTRACT scientific owner. Consume exact EXTRACT checkpoints, artifacts, benchmark/result evidence, and frozen gates; identify methodological or contract inconsistencies; assess downstream compatibility with the opaque semantic-control integration socket; and publish bounded review findings in workspace-control without changing EXTRACT science, implementation, acceptance criteria, or semantic-control production behavior.
acceptance_criteria: research-engine-local-extract-redesign-v1 remains the sole owner of EXTRACT hypotheses, architecture selection, prompts, retrieval/generation, model choices, benchmarks, scientific acceptance criteria, experiment execution, and scientific verdicts.
This task mutates only its own workspace-control capsule and derived Markdown handoff; research-engine and the EXTRACT/integration/hardening task capsules remain read-only.
Every review finding is grounded in exact durable Git SHAs, artifact/report identities, frozen gates, or CI/runtime evidence and distinguishes observed evidence from reviewer interpretation.

Review findings may identify methodological inconsistencies, control drift, invalid gate claims, missing evidence, or downstream bindability concerns, but may not rewrite EXTRACT gates post hoc or issue the EXTRACT scientific verdict.

Downstream compatibility review treats the hardening opaque EXTRACT socket as consumer-side only: EXTRACT is not required to emit RDF, ontology-native structures, SemanticObservationV1, or any semantic-control-specific payload.

No review finding can grant authorization, production promotion, or semantic-control authority; semantic-control integration remains BLOCKED_EVIDENCE until the EXTRACT owner durably identifies a genuinely accepted architecture/output contract with exact artifact/schema identity.
When a new EXTRACT design or result checkpoint appears, this task can independently audit it and persist a compact review checkpoint that the owning EXTRACT chat can consume through Git.

If a genuinely accepted EXTRACT output contract appears, this task performs a bindability audit only; actual AcceptedExtractOutput -> SemanticObservationV1 adapter implementation remains owned by workspace-semantic-control-integration-v1.
constraints: Do not mutate tasks/active/research-engine-local-extract-redesign-v1.json or its Markdown handoff.
Do not mutate tasks/active/workspace-semantic-control-integration-v1.json, workspace-semantic-control-hardening-v1.json, or their handoffs.
Do not modify research-engine code, workflows, benchmarks, prompts, routes, model configuration, production EXTRACT/VERIFY, or scientific artifacts.
Do not start, rerun, cancel, or otherwise control EXTRACT experiments.
Do not propose a competing EXTRACT architecture as an alternate scientific owner. Review the owning task's durable choices and evidence instead.
Do not impose semantic-control ontology/schema requirements upstream on EXTRACT.
Do not convert FEASIBLE, PARTIAL, validation-design progress, or reviewer approval into an accepted EXTRACT output contract.
Do not hold Heartbeat while idle; use this task only during an active review/reconciliation turn.
